sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:77

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:77:1
items.html:
The body of man is divided into two parts, etc., down to the Chazeh the Yesod of Bina expands and the lights within it are covered, and from the Chazeh downward the lights are revealed: The great discernment between from the Chazeh and upward and from the Chazeh and downward was already explained above: for down to the Chazeh the posterior of Ima illuminate, and there is no possibility whatsoever for the shells to suck from there; but from the Chazeh and downward the posterior of Ima have already ceased, and the shells can grip there. However, in contrast, it is found that all the merit of the Partzuf is revealed only from the Chazeh and downward, for from the Chazeh and upward the Hassadim are found sealed in the Yesod of Ima — meaning that the illumination of Hochma cannot be revealed there, because of the posterior of Ima, which repel Hochma in the secret of “for He desires mercy.” Thus, the illumination of Hochma is not revealed in the Partzuf except from the Chazeh and downward, namely, only after the screen of the Yesod of Ima has ceased.
And this is what he says: “And therefore his body was divided between two worlds: his covered upper half is placed in the last six of Yetzira, and his revealed lower half is placed in the first four of Assiya” — that is, as above, that there is a very great difference between from the Chazeh and upward, where the shells have no grip whatsoever, and from the Chazeh and downward, where the shells have the power to grip; and therefore from the Chazeh and upward is regarded as the aspect of Yetzira and the aspect of the male, and from the Chazeh and downward is regarded as the aspect of Assiya and the aspect of the Nukva.
